back_to_back_terraces.name: Back-to-Back Terraces
back_to_back_terraces.observation: Two rows of cottages share one rear wall, each a single room over a single room, with one privy at the court's end for forty souls.
back_to_back_terraces.social_consequence: Mill hands get a roof within a walk of the gate; their children breathe the courtyard's stale air and fevers pass wall to wall.

steam_pumped_waterworks.name: Steam Pumped Waterworks
steam_pumped_waterworks.observation: A beam engine in a tall brick house thumps day and night, lifting river water to a hilltop reservoir from which iron mains run down every street.

gas_lit_streets.name: Gas-Lit Streets
gas_lit_streets.observation: At dusk the lamplighter walks his round with a ladder and pole, and one by one the iron posts bloom with a steady yellow flame.
gas_lit_streets.ability_reason: Coal gas piped from the works turns night streets into usable, policed space, lengthening the working and trading day in every lit town.

iron_roof_trusses.name: Iron Roof Trusses
iron_roof_trusses.observation: Slender iron ties and struts bolted into triangles span the new shed wall to wall, with no forest of posts on the floor below.

iron_roofed_market_halls.name: Covered Market Halls
iron_roofed_market_halls.observation: Under a roof of iron ribs and glass the stalls stand dry in the rain, and the smell of fish and oranges fills the whole bright nave.

chain_suspension_bridges.name: Chain Suspension Bridges
chain_suspension_bridges.observation: Two stone towers carry great chains of wrought-iron links across the river, and the roadway hangs from them on iron rods high above the masts.
chain_suspension_bridges.ability_reason: A single span across a wide navigable river joins roads the ferry once broke, without piers to block the shipping below.

portland_cement_clinker.name: Clinker Cement
portland_cement_clinker.observation: Burned hot enough to half melt, chalk and clay come out of the kiln as grey clinker; ground fine, it sets hard as rock even under water.
portland_cement_clinker.ability_reason: A cement that hardens underwater and can be made by the ton opens docks, sewers and foundations that lime mortar could never hold.

cast_iron_street_fronts.name: Cast-Iron Fronts
cast_iron_street_fronts.observation: Whole shop fronts arrive from the foundry in numbered pieces, columns and arches bolted up in a week and painted to look like carved stone.

tunnelling_shield.name: Tunnelling Shield
tunnelling_shield.observation: Miners work in iron cells at the face of the drift, digging a hand's breadth ahead while jacks push the whole frame forward through the river mud.
tunnelling_shield.ability_reason: A moving iron shield holds up soft, wet ground long enough for brick lining, so roads can pass under rivers where no bridge can stand.

light_stud_frame_houses.name: Light Stud Framing
light_stud_frame_houses.observation: Two men with machine-sawn studs and a keg of cut nails raise a house frame in days, with no mortise and no master joiner.

brick_arch_viaducts.name: Brick Arch Viaducts
brick_arch_viaducts.observation: Forty brick arches stride across the valley floor, each the twin of the last, carrying the level line over the farms and mill leats below.

model_worker_dwellings.name: Model Dwellings
model_worker_dwellings.observation: The new block has a tap and a water closet on every stair landing, whitewashed walls, and a window that opens in every room.

egg_shaped_sewers.name: Egg-Shaped Sewers
egg_shaped_sewers.observation: The new sewer stands narrow end down like an egg, so even a trickle runs fast enough to carry the filth away instead of settling.

riveted_box_girder_bridges.name: Box-Girder Bridges
riveted_box_girder_bridges.observation: The bridge is a great iron tube of riveted plates, so stiff that a loaded train rolls through it with barely a tremor.

prefabricated_iron_glass_halls.name: Iron-and-Glass Halls
prefabricated_iron_glass_halls.observation: Thousands of identical panes, columns and gutters come off the works by rail, and in a single season a glass hall rises taller than the elms beside it.
prefabricated_iron_glass_halls.ability_reason: Building from standard interchangeable parts turns a year of masonry into weeks of assembly and shows every visitor what the workshops can do.

timber_lateral_bracing.observation: Diagonal braces let into the studs at every corner stop the frame racking when the gale leans on its side.

compressed_air_systems.observation: An engine-driven compressor fills a riveted receiver, and iron pipes carry the hissing air to drills and hoists far down the workings.

mechanical_refrigeration.observation: In the cold store the compressor thuds behind a wall, and frost furs the pipes over carcasses hung in rows in the middle of summer.

safety_lifts.observation: The builder rides his lift to the top floor, has the rope cut before the crowd, and the car jolts to a stop, gripped by its toothed catches.
safety_lifts.ability_reason: A car that cannot fall if its rope parts makes upper floors as valuable as lower ones, so buildings can climb well past the stair limit.

rolled_iron_floor_beams.name: Rolled Iron Beams
rolled_iron_floor_beams.observation: Iron beams shaped like a capital I come from the rolling mill in stock lengths, and shallow brick arches spring between them to make floors fire cannot drop.

radiator_central_heating.name: Radiator Heating
radiator_central_heating.observation: A single boiler in the cellar sends hot water rising through every floor, and the iron radiators under the windows tick as they warm.

intercepting_sewers.name: Intercepting Sewers
intercepting_sewers.observation: Great brick tunnels run along the riverbanks, catching every old outfall and carrying the town's waste miles downstream before it meets the water.
intercepting_sewers.ability_reason: Sewage no longer pours into the river beside the water intakes, and the town's summer fevers and choking stink begin to fall away together.
intercepting_sewers.social_consequence: Crowded riverside quarters are healthier at once; villages further downstream now receive what the town once kept.

rock_oil_well_drilling.name: Rock Oil Wells
rock_oil_well_drilling.observation: A timber derrick stands over the bore, the steam engine lifting and dropping the heavy bit until black oil wells up into the barrels.

boulevard_reconstruction.name: Grand Boulevards
boulevard_reconstruction.observation: Wreckers tear straight through the old lanes; behind them come broad tree-lined avenues, and under the paving run sewers, water mains and gas.
boulevard_reconstruction.ability_reason: Cutting wide avenues through the crowded core lets air, traffic, pipes and troops move through a capital that had choked on its own lanes.
boulevard_reconstruction.social_consequence: Shopkeepers and landlords on the new avenues prosper; the families whose lanes were demolished are pushed to the edges of the city.

sewer_rodding_service.name: Sewer Rodding Crews
sewer_rodding_service.observation: A crew lifts the iron cover, screws rod to rod down the manhole, and twists until the choke breaks and the flow gurgles free.

pneumatic_caissons.name: Pneumatic Caissons
pneumatic_caissons.observation: Men dig the riverbed in a sealed iron chamber under pressed air, and some come up bent double with cramps no doctor can explain.

rock_drill_tunnelling.name: Rock Drill Tunnels
rock_drill_tunnelling.observation: The air drills hammer six holes at once into the mountain face, the powder goes in, and the whole gang retreats before the rumble.

steel_long_span_bridges.name: Steel Long-Span Bridges
steel_long_span_bridges.observation: Two steel cantilevers reach out from their piers across the firth, a gang riveting at each tip, until the arms meet in midair.
steel_long_span_bridges.ability_reason: Cheap strong steel lets a single bridge cross estuaries and gorges that broke every road and line before, stitching whole regions together.

asphalt_street_paving.name: Asphalt Paving
asphalt_street_paving.observation: A gang rakes steaming black asphalt over the concrete bed, and the roller leaves a street that is quiet under wheels and washes clean in rain.

building_codes.name: Building Codes
building_codes.observation: The inspector measures the stair width and counts windows against his printed rules, and the builder's half-finished row fails the check.

hydraulic_power_mains.name: Hydraulic Power Mains
hydraulic_power_mains.observation: Water pumped to great pressure runs through mains under the docks, and at a turned valve a crane lifts a bale or a swing bridge opens.

water_towers.name: Water Towers
water_towers.observation: An iron tank on brick legs stands above the rooftops, and the firemen's hose at the hydrant now throws water clear over the eaves.

piped_hot_water_bathrooms.name: Piped Bathrooms
piped_hot_water_bathrooms.observation: In the clerk's terraced house a copper geyser heats the bath, and the family bathe in their own room instead of queueing at the public baths.

hollow_tile_fireproof_floors.name: Hollow Tile Floors
hollow_tile_fireproof_floors.observation: Between the iron beams the masons set flat arches of hollow fired-clay blocks, light enough to span wide and proof against the fiercest blaze.

electric_street_lighting.name: Electric Street Lamps
electric_street_lighting.observation: The arc lamps sputter into life over the square with a white glare that turns the gas mantles yellow and dim by comparison.

central_power_stations.name: Central Power Stations
central_power_stations.observation: Coal barges tie up by the new station, where rows of dynamos hum, and copper wire carries their current to every lamp and motor in the district.
central_power_stations.ability_reason: One large plant generating for a whole district replaces a hundred small engines, putting cheap power into shops and homes that never had any.
central_power_stations.social_consequence: Workshops without an engine of their own can now run motors; the neighbourhood around the station lives under its smoke.

refuse_destructors.name: Refuse Destructors
refuse_destructors.observation: The dust carts come on fixed days now, and at the depot the town's rubbish is shovelled into furnaces whose heat raises steam for the pumps.

wire_cable_suspension_bridges.name: Wire-Cable Suspension
wire_cable_suspension_bridges.observation: Spinning wheels shuttle back and forth over the towers laying wire after wire, until the bundled cables are thick as a man and hold a mile of roadway.
wire_cable_suspension_bridges.ability_reason: Cables spun from thousands of steel wires hang spans several times longer than chains could, bridging harbours and straits once thought impassable.

structural_steel.name: Steel Skeleton Frames
structural_steel.observation: Ironworkers walk bare girders ten storeys up, catching red-hot rivets in buckets, while the masons below hang thin walls on a frame that carries itself.
structural_steel.ability_reason: Walls no longer bear the building's weight, so height is limited by steel and lifts rather than by the thickness of the ground floor.

reinforced_concrete.observation: Carpenters build a wooden mould, fitters lay a cage of iron rods inside it, and the wet concrete poured around them sets into beams that neither burn nor rot.
reinforced_concrete.ability_reason: Steel taking tension and concrete taking compression gives a cheap, fireproof, mouldable material for floors, piers, tanks and bridges.

wound_transformers.observation: A squat iron case full of oil and copper windings hums softly on its pole, stepping the station's high pressure down to what a lamp can bear.

plate_glass_shopfronts.name: Plate-Glass Shopfronts
plate_glass_shopfronts.observation: Whole panes taller than a man frame the draper's window, and passers-by stop to stare at goods laid out as if in a lit room.

skeleton_frame_towers.name: Skeleton-Frame Towers
skeleton_frame_towers.observation: The new office block rises twenty storeys on its steel cage, electric lifts humming in their shafts and clerks filing into every floor by eight.
skeleton_frame_towers.ability_reason: Steel frames and electric lifts together let a crowded centre stack its counting-houses and offices upward instead of spreading outward.

street_utility_ducts.name: Underground Utility Ducts
street_utility_ducts.observation: The forest of poles and sagging wires comes down; linesmen pull the cables through brick ducts beneath the pavement instead.

alternating_current_grids.name: Alternating-Current Grids
alternating_current_grids.observation: Steel towers march across the fields carrying bare wires at killing pressure, and a works forty miles from any coalfield runs its motors from them.
alternating_current_grids.ability_reason: Stepping current up to high pressure lets distant stations serve many towns at once, so power no longer has to be made where it is used.

mountain_gravity_aqueducts.name: Mountain Aqueducts
mountain_gravity_aqueducts.observation: Clear upland water runs a hundred miles downhill through tunnels and siphons, never pumped once, and pours from the city's taps cold and sweet.

hydroelectric_stations.name: Hydroelectric Stations
hydroelectric_stations.observation: Water drops from the weir through steel pipes into turbines, and the power house hums with no coal pile and no smoke.
hydroelectric_stations.ability_reason: Falling water turned straight into current gives power without burning fuel, making river valleys new centres of industry.

battery_bank_wiring.name: Station Battery Rooms
battery_bank_wiring.observation: Rows of glass jars of lead plates and acid fill the battery room, fizzing as they charge by night and carrying the evening lamps when the dynamos falter.

concrete_compaction_practice.name: Concrete Compaction
concrete_compaction_practice.observation: Labourers ram rods up and down in the fresh pour and tap the forms with mallets until the air bubbles stop rising.

concrete_curing_control.name: Concrete Curing
concrete_curing_control.observation: The new slab lies under wet sacking for a fortnight, a boy sluicing it morning and evening so it hardens slowly and does not crack.

refrigerated_air_conditioning.name: Refrigerated Cooling
refrigerated_air_conditioning.observation: In midsummer the printing hall stays cool and dry, chilled air breathing from grilles while the paper no longer swells and smudges.

steel_sheet_pile_cofferdams.name: Sheet-Pile Cofferdams
steel_sheet_pile_cofferdams.observation: The steam hammer drives interlocking steel piles in a ring through the river, and within days pumps have the enclosed bed dry for the masons.

reinforced_concrete_bridges.name: Concrete Bridges
reinforced_concrete_bridges.observation: A single flat concrete arch leaps the gorge, poured over a timber centring, and needs no paint and no riveters once the forms come down.

activated_sludge_treatment.name: Activated Sludge Works
activated_sludge_treatment.observation: Air bubbles up through long concrete tanks of sewage, the brown froth settles, and the water spilling over the far weir runs almost clear.

zoning_ordinances.name: Zoning Ordinances
zoning_ordinances.observation: The planning office hangs a coloured map: red for works, yellow for shops, green for houses, and no new tannery may open beside a school.

concrete_arch_dams.name: Concrete Dams
concrete_arch_dams.observation: The concrete wall curves between the valley's rock sides, three hundred feet high, and behind it a lake fills where villages and orchards stood.
concrete_arch_dams.ability_reason: A great dam stores a season's floods for dry months and turbines, turning a wild river into a regulated supply of water and power.
concrete_arch_dams.social_consequence: Towns downstream gain water, power and flood safety; the farmers of the drowned valley lose their fields and graves.

shallow_foundation_assessment.name: Soil Bearing Tests
shallow_foundation_assessment.observation: Surveyors dig trial pits, load a plate with iron weights and watch it sink, then size the footings to what the clay will bear.

charge_regulation.name: Automatic Charge Regulators
charge_regulation.observation: A relay clicks over by itself when the battery bank is full, and the attendant no longer sits up all night watching the gauge.

public_housing_estates.name: Public Housing Estates
public_housing_estates.observation: Rows of brick cottages with gardens, indoor lavatories and gas cookers stand where the slum courts were, let at rents the town sets itself.
public_housing_estates.ability_reason: When the town builds and lets decent housing itself, working families escape private slums that the market alone had never replaced.
public_housing_estates.social_consequence: Families on the waiting list gain sound homes; private landlords lose tenants, and the rates must carry the debt.

water_cement_ratio_design.name: Water-Cement Ratio
water_cement_ratio_design.observation: The engineer weighs the water as carefully as the cement, casts sample cubes from each batch, and crushes them in a press after a month.

thin_concrete_shell_roofs.name: Thin Shell Roofs
thin_concrete_shell_roofs.observation: A curved concrete skin no thicker than a hand spans the whole hangar, with no column to break the floor beneath it.

rural_electrification.name: Rural Electrification
rural_electrification.observation: The poles reach the last farm on the ridge, and the family gather in the kitchen to watch the first bulb glow over the table.
rural_electrification.ability_reason: Carrying lines to thin-settled country ends the divide between electric towns and dark villages, bringing pumps, milking machines and light to the farm.
rural_electrification.social_consequence: Farm households gain light, pumps and radio; the lines are paid for from town rates and public loans.

buried_pipe_load_assessment.name: Buried Pipe Loading
buried_pipe_load_assessment.observation: Engineers load lengths of pipe in a trench of packed gravel until they crack, then set the cover depth under every road crossing by the results.

foundation_settlement_monitoring.name: Settlement Monitoring
foundation_settlement_monitoring.observation: Twice a year the surveyor levels brass studs set in the tower's base, and his ledger shows the north corner sinking a hair each season.

river_basin_works.name: River-Basin Authority
river_basin_works.observation: From the headwaters to the delta a single authority rules the river: a stair of dams, locks and power houses, and floods that no longer come.
river_basin_works.ability_reason: Planning a whole river as one system controls floods, opens navigation and multiplies power far beyond what scattered works could manage.
river_basin_works.social_consequence: Valley towns gain cheap power and freedom from floods; tens of thousands of hill farmers are moved off land that becomes lakebed.

prestressed_concrete.name: Prestressed Concrete
prestressed_concrete.observation: Jacks stretch steel tendons through the beam before it takes any load, so it arches faintly upward and carries twice the span without cracking.
prestressed_concrete.ability_reason: Squeezing concrete in advance with tensioned steel gives long, slim, crack-free members for bridges, tanks and floors from far less material.

pumped_storage_hydro.name: Pumped Storage
pumped_storage_hydro.observation: At night the machines run backward and pump the lower lake uphill; at supper time the water rushes down again to meet the grid's peak.

building_wind_load_assessment.name: Wind-Load Design
building_wind_load_assessment.observation: A balsa model of the tower stands in the wind tunnel while gauges record the pressure on every face before a single girder is ordered.

engineered_wood_lamination.name: Glued Laminated Timber
engineered_wood_lamination.observation: Short planks glued and clamped layer on layer become a great curved arch, far longer and truer than any single tree could give.

reactor_engineering.name: Controlled Reactors
reactor_engineering.observation: In the concrete hall control rods creep out a finger's width at a time, the counters' clicking quickens, and the needles settle at a steady heat.
reactor_engineering.ability_reason: Holding a chain reaction steady under cooling, shielding and instruments makes it possible to raise steam from a new kind of fuel.

fluorescent_lighting.name: Fluorescent Lighting
fluorescent_lighting.observation: Long white tubes flicker and catch across the drawing office ceiling, casting an even shadowless light over every desk at a third of the cost.

welded_steel_frames.name: Welded Steel Frames
welded_steel_frames.observation: No rivet gangs and no hammering now; a welder in a dark mask runs a blue-white bead round each joint and the frame goes up quietly.

climbing_tower_cranes.name: Climbing Tower Cranes
climbing_tower_cranes.observation: The slim crane jacks itself up inside the lift shaft as the floors rise, swinging steel and concrete skips over the city from forty storeys.

building_capillary_breaks.name: Damp-Proof Courses
building_capillary_breaks.observation: A strip of bitumen felt laid under the first course of bricks, and a sheet under the slab, keep the ground's damp from climbing the parlour walls.

conduit_infiltration_testing.name: Sewer Infiltration Tests
conduit_infiltration_testing.observation: The crew plugs both ends of a sewer run, fills it to the mark, and times how fast the level falls to find where groundwater leaks in.

timber_moisture_movement_design.name: Timber Movement Joints
timber_moisture_movement_design.observation: The joiner leaves slotted bolt holes and gaps at each floor so the timber can swell in wet winters and shrink in summer without splitting.

slipformed_concrete_cores.name: Slipformed Cores
slipformed_concrete_cores.observation: The steel form climbs a few inches an hour on its jacks, day and night, and the grain silo rises from the prairie as one seamless concrete tube.

curtain_wall_systems.name: Glazed Curtain Walls
curtain_wall_systems.observation: Aluminium mullions and sheets of glass are clipped to the frame floor by floor, and the tower becomes a mirror for the clouds.

nuclear_power_stations.name: Nuclear Power Stations
nuclear_power_stations.observation: A domed concrete containment and a tall cooling tower stand by the estuary, feeding the grid day and night with no smoke from the chimney.
nuclear_power_stations.ability_reason: A handful of reactor stations can carry a region's base load for decades on a few truckloads of fuel, loosening the grid's grip on coal.
nuclear_power_stations.social_consequence: Industry gains steady cheap power and cleaner air; the towns beside the station carry the fear of an accident and the problem of spent fuel.

cable_stayed_bridges.name: Cable-Stayed Bridges
cable_stayed_bridges.observation: Fans of straight cables run from a single tall pylon to the deck, and the bridge is built outward segment by segment without falsework in the river.

rainscreen_wall_assemblies.name: Rainscreen Walls
rainscreen_wall_assemblies.observation: The cladding panels hang an inch clear of the wall on battens, so wind-driven rain runs down the cavity and drains out at the base.

precast_panel_housing.name: Precast Panel Housing
precast_panel_housing.observation: Lorries bring whole walls, windows already set, from the panel works, and a crane stacks a nine-storey block in weeks like a child's box of cards.
precast_panel_housing.social_consequence: Tens of thousands move from huts and cellars into warm flats; the identical estates weather badly and neighbours complain of lonely stairwells.

seawater_desalination.name: Seawater Desalination
seawater_desalination.observation: Seawater is forced through bundles of membranes at great pressure, fresh water trickling out one side and bitter brine piped back to sea.

tunnel_boring_machines.name: Tunnel Boring Machines
tunnel_boring_machines.observation: A cutter wheel wider than a house grinds forward under the city, lining the bore with concrete rings behind it, while traffic rolls unaware above.

direct_current_links.name: Direct-Current Links
direct_current_links.observation: A cable laid along the seabed joins two grids a hundred miles apart, the converter halls at each end humming with rectifier valves.

framed_tube_supertall.name: Framed-Tube Towers
framed_tube_supertall.observation: Closely spaced outer columns make the whole face of the tower one stiff tube, and it climbs past a hundred storeys above the harbour.

cable_net_membrane_roofs.name: Cable-Net Roofs
cable_net_membrane_roofs.observation: A translucent membrane stretched over a net of steel cables floats above the stadium stands like a sail pinned to the sky.

ductile_seismic_codes.name: Seismic Design Codes
ductile_seismic_codes.observation: After the last quake the new rules demand tied columns and closely hooped steel, so frames bend and hold instead of shattering.

seismic_base_isolation.name: Seismic Base Isolation
seismic_base_isolation.observation: The hospital sits on rubber and lead bearings; in the tremor the ground lurches while the wards above sway slowly and the patients sleep on.

nutrient_removal_treatment.name: Nutrient Removal
nutrient_removal_treatment.observation: Extra tanks strip the nitrogen and phosphorus from the treated flow, and within a few summers the estuary's green scum and dead fish are gone.

trenchless_pipe_relining.name: Trenchless Relining
trenchless_pipe_relining.observation: A resin-soaked felt sleeve is pushed through the century-old sewer and cured hot inside it, making a new pipe without opening the street.

photovoltaic_power.name: Solar Power Plants
photovoltaic_power.observation: Rank on rank of dark glass panels tilt toward the sun across what was scrubland, and inverters in small huts feed the midday current to the grid.
photovoltaic_power.ability_reason: Once panels grow cheap, sunlight becomes a fuel-free source that can be built anywhere in months, from a roof to a desert field.

wind_turbine_farms.name: Wind Farms
wind_turbine_farms.observation: White three-bladed towers turn slowly along the ridge line, each taller than a church spire, humming in the evening wind.

storm_surge_barriers.name: Storm-Surge Barriers
storm_surge_barriers.observation: When the storm warning comes the great steel gates swing up from the estuary bed and the surge breaks against them while the city stays dry.

building_management_systems.name: Building Management Systems
building_management_systems.observation: A screen in the basement shows every floor's heat and airflow; the computer dims empty offices and warns the caretaker before a pump fails.

accessible_building_rules.name: Accessible Buildings
accessible_building_rules.observation: Ramps now rise beside the courthouse steps, doors open wide at a button, and a wheelchair user takes the lift to the public gallery unaided.

low_energy_building_codes.name: Energy Building Codes
low_energy_building_codes.observation: The inspector checks insulation depth, triple glazing and airtight seals; the new houses are warmed in winter mostly by their occupants and appliances.

combined_cycle_stations.name: Combined-Cycle Stations
combined_cycle_stations.observation: Gas burns in a turbine, and its hot exhaust boils water for a second steam turbine, so the station gets twice the work from every cubic foot.

acoustic_leak_detection.name: Acoustic Leak Detection
acoustic_leak_detection.observation: Listening sensors clamped to the mains pick out the faint hiss of a split pipe under the road, and the crew digs one hole instead of fifty.

green_cool_roofs.name: Green and Cool Roofs
green_cool_roofs.observation: Sedum and grasses cover the warehouse roofs, pale coatings the rest, and in the heatwave the district stays several degrees cooler than its neighbours.

smart_grid_metering.name: Smart Grid Metering
smart_grid_metering.observation: Meters report each household's use every few minutes, and at the evening peak the grid quietly shifts water heaters and car chargers to later hours.

rooftop_solar_home_batteries.name: Rooftop Solar
rooftop_solar_home_batteries.observation: Dark panels cover half the roofs on the street, and when a storm takes the lines down the lamps in those houses stay lit from the battery in the garage.

offshore_wind_farms.name: Offshore Wind Farms
offshore_wind_farms.observation: Far out past the sandbanks hundreds of giant turbines stand on steel legs and floating hulls, their blades longer than a ship.

mass_timber_towers.name: Mass Timber Towers
mass_timber_towers.observation: Cross-laminated panels of spruce arrive cut to the millimetre, and an eighteen-storey tower of wood rises with barely a hammer's sound.

grid_scale_batteries.name: Grid-Scale Batteries
grid_scale_batteries.observation: Rows of white containers packed with cells fill an old coal yard, soaking up the noon sun's surplus and returning it to the grid after dark.
grid_scale_batteries.ability_reason: Storing hours of surplus sun and wind lets renewable power carry the evening peak, the last task that still needed a fuel-burning plant.

sponge_districts.name: Sponge Districts
sponge_districts.observation: After the cloudburst the sunken park fills like a pond, porous pavements drink the rest, and the streets that always flooded stay passable.

heat_pump_district_networks.name: Heat Pump Networks
heat_pump_district_networks.observation: Gas boilers come out of every flat; warm water drawn from the river and lifted by great heat pumps now runs through insulated pipes to every radiator.

printed_concrete_houses.name: Printed Concrete Houses
printed_concrete_houses.observation: A gantry nozzle lays ribbon after ribbon of quick-setting concrete, and by the end of the week a house's walls stand with only a two-man crew.

near_zero_energy_retrofits.name: Near-Zero Retrofits
near_zero_energy_retrofits.observation: Scaffolds wrap the old brick blocks in thick insulation and new windows, and the tenants' heating bills fall to a fraction of last winter's.

low_carbon_cement.name: Low-Carbon Cement
low_carbon_cement.observation: The kiln burns less clinker blended with slag and calcined clay, and a capture plant strips the stack's gas before it reaches the sky.

small_modular_reactors.name: Small Modular Reactors
small_modular_reactors.observation: The reactor arrives by barge in a single factory-built module, sunk into a pit beside the old coal station and connected to its switchyard.
